candidates.spoken: 15,000 new routes knocked old routers offline.
Many older routers could only hold 512,000 routes.
The internet's routing table passed 512,000 entries.
They were fixed within 5 minutes, yet instability lasted hours.
Every network announces which addresses it can reach, using BGP.
The new routes were reaggregated within 5 minutes.
Networks announce which address blocks they can reach.
It happened in August 2014, starting at 07:48 UTC.
What stops if border gateway routing system stops?
Replacing border gateway routing system is not a simple purchase.

script.spoken: 15,000 new routes knocked old routers offline. The internet's routing table passed 512,000 entries. Every network announces which addresses it can reach, using BGP. Many older routers could only hold 512,000 routes. It happened in August 2014, starting at 07:48 UTC. They were fixed within 5 minutes, yet instability lasted hours. That's why the internet's map can outgrow the machines reading it.
